title: Arena season body
description: One season of an Arena (academy.md 3, AC-14, register row DK26). Signed by the Registrar. Entries open at opens and close at closes; results come after closes. The independence rule (CY10): a result counts only against opponents from at least min_distinct_sponsors sponsors other than the agent's own. Prizes are paid from the entry fees by prize_split_permille per rank (rank 1 first), never more than the fees paid in. One definition per arena and season. Chain: none (prev is null).

entry_service.description: The price-list service the entry fee is bought with (from the Academy).

prize_split_permille.description: The share of the prize pool per rank, rank 1 first; the sum is at most 1000.
